captions: Select a linked CI name in the inventory table.
Check the record name, Asset ID and snapshot before interpreting the details.
scenes.title: Open the record

captions: Read the Field and Value pairs; search within the detail table if needed.
Available fields vary by CI type. Missing values need follow-up with the owner.
scenes.title: Read the details for this type of item

captions: Choose Explore Topology to use this CI as the starting point.
The topology uses the panel snapshot; inventory table filters do not carry across.
scenes.title: Look at the item's relationships

captions: Return to the explorer and open the record again.
Press Escape or Close to return to the control that opened the panel.
scenes.title: Return to the table
